title: User and System Bot
description: The user talks only with the overall System Bot. System Bot accepts the build request, tracks the PM, Foreman council, and 100-worker pool run, then returns the final package.

messages.text: Start run from workspace/Craft_Utopia/tiantan.png. Target: build the visible Tiantan structure in Minecraft and write generated files under workspace/Craft_Utopia/runs/tiantan_build_001.
Request accepted. I created the run directory, pinned the input checksum, and opened a Project Manager channel for planning.
Project Manager has a blueprint and a Foreman-A to Foreman-E plan. The 100 workers are grouped into five synchronized worker-pool rooms now.
messages.systemLog: orchestrator INFO pm_status=plan_ready blueprint=9274 placements foreman_pools=5 workers=100

messages.text: Run complete. Final outputs are final_world.schem, report.json, replay.jsonl, and a tarball with the raw execution logs.
